name: How does natural stone tile compare to porcelain tile in a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How does natural stone tile compare to porcelain tile in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Natural stone like marble, slate, or travertine delivers a timeless, luxurious finish, but it requires regular sealing and specialized pH-neutral cleaners to prevent staining and water etching. Porcelain tile can convincingly mimic the look of natural marble or slate while remaining completely waterproof, stain-proof, and virtually maintenance-free. If you want minimal upkeep without worrying about bath products discoloring the stone, porcelain is the practical option. If natural stone variation is essential, plan for ongoing surface sealing as part of routine care.
acceptedAnswer.description: Natural stone provides unique natural beauty but requires periodic sealing, whereas porcelain is impervious to water, stain-resistant, and virtually maintenance-free.
